name: Stage brandy
text: Heals 4 HP to you and every ally in the room.

name: Whetstone
text: In battle: Strengthened (+2 Might) for the battle.

name: Incense
text: In battle: Focused (+2 Sanity) for the battle.

name: Padded coat
text: In battle: Guarded (the next hit is halved).

name: Lantern
text: Your light reaches one step further.

name: Crucifix
text: Wakes a downed guest in your room. Used up.

name: Rosary
text: Wakes a downed guest in your room. Used up.

name: Phoenix crown
text: A singer's crown of gilt phoenixes, made for the house's last great opening night.

name: The patron's Ledger
text: A black ledger of what the house owes, and to whom.

name: Gilded mask
text: The jewel of the patron's collection: a mask with tears of gold leaf.

name: A pocket watch
text: A father's watch, engraved with a daughter's name. It stopped at seven.

name: A ring of keys
text: Forty years of doors on one iron ring.
